To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the 3D model of the ligand binding domain of the ionotropic glutamate receptors, built on the basis of the structure of the bacterial PBPs, is a very good approximation of the actual crystal structure.
the 3D structure of the liganded ligand-binding domain is similar to that predicted by molecular modelling.

(i) a 3D model based on the crystal structure of an unrelated protein (the PBP of Escherichia coli maltose-binding protein) could predict the crystallographic structure of the liganded ligand-binding domain, and (ii) the model was able to predict the crystallographically determined conformation of the ligand and its interaction with the protein.

molecular modelling is a powerful tool for generating 3D models that can predict, at least in part, the structure of the ligands-binding domain of ionotropic glutamate receptors.

the models were able to predict the 3D structure of the liganded domain with an accuracy of about 2.5-3 Å, which is comparable to the accuracy achieved by other molecular modelling studies of protein structures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 3D models could correctly predict the overall shape of this domain, but not the detailed arrangement of the amino acid residues at the ligand-binding site.
the 3D models were able to provide a reasonable description of the overall structure, but they were not able to predict the details of the structure.
, despite the fact that some of our models were very accurate, the 3D models were unable to predict the overall fold of the domain, which was the main objective of this work.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in the case of the glutamate receptors, the 3D structure of the liganded form of the ligand binding domain can be accurately predicted using molecular models based on the crystal structure of a PBP.

the 3D models were not able to correctly predict the crystal structure, but that they were useful in the design of site-specific mutants that were able to probe specific aspects of the structure of the domain.
, in general, the 3D models were not able to predict the structure of the ligands' binding sites, but they did predict well the overall structure of the domain.
